airdrops.name: Fables
airdrops.desc: Points claim and PROLOGUE redemption close on November 20 at 23:59 UTC. Unclaimed FABLES are not minted.
steps: Open the Fables website and go to the portfolio section
Connect the same wallet that received your points (PROLOGUE: the wallet that held it at the Oct 17 snapshot)
Use the "Claim your FABLES" card and pick the option you saved by Oct 19 (FABLES or locked veFABLES)
Do not move PROLOGUE out of that wallet: any outgoing transfer cancels the whole claim

airdrops.name: Treehouse Season 2
airdrops.desc: Season 2 claim is open until November 25, 07:00 UTC. Unclaimed tokens return to the treasury.
steps: Check eligibility: 500+ Final Nuts at the Apr 25 snapshot, a Season 2 governance vote, or a Squirrel Council NFT
Open the official claim portal linked from the Treehouse announcement and choose "Season 2"
Connect the wallet you used during the campaign and claim once
Treehouse never sends claim links by DM: ignore any you receive

airdrops.name: Doppler Finance
airdrops.desc: Genesis airdrop of 100M XDP (1% of supply), fully unlocked. Registration closed on July 30; claims end November 28, 12:00 UTC.
steps: Only wallets registered by July 30, 2026 are eligible
Open the official Doppler airdrop portal
Connect the Base wallet you registered and claim before the deadline

airdrops.name: Predict.fun
airdrops.desc: Pick how to receive your allocation by November 26: part now with the rest forfeited, or 100% after a one-year stake. Date reported by press, check the official site.
steps: Open predict.fun and connect the wallet you used
Option A: take 35% now, the remaining 65% is forfeited
Option B: receive 100% after a one-year stake (this is the default if you choose nothing)
Confirm the deadline on the official site before deciding

airdrops.name: Aster Stage 6
airdrops.desc: Stage 6 "Convergence" distributes 64M ASTER to users who chose the full vested allocation. Claim before December 4, 12:00 UTC.
steps: Open the official Aster allocation page
Connect the wallet that holds your points (10,000+ points needed)
Claim your full allocation before December 4, 12:00 UTC

airdrops.name: Midnight Glacier Drop
airdrops.desc: The Thaw phase of Midnight's Glacier Drop ends December 4, followed by a 90-day grace period. Tokens unlock in four 25% instalments.
steps: Read the official NIGHT redemption guide
Open the official redemption portal from that guide
Claim each 25% instalment as it unlocks

airdrops.name: Zest Protocol S1
airdrops.desc: Season 1 ZEST unlock claim, reported for November 19 to December 10. Not yet confirmed on the project site, so verify before claiming.
steps: Find the claim link on Zest Protocol's official X account or website
Connect the wallet you used in Season 1
Claim your unlocked ZEST before December 10

airdrops.name: Variational (Omni)
airdrops.desc: Perp DEX on Arbitrum. 32% of VAR goes to points holders, fully unlocked at TGE planned for Q4 2026. 150,000 points are still added each week.
steps: Open the Omni app from variational.io and connect an Arbitrum wallet
Deposit a small amount of USDC
Trade perps: points are distributed every Friday based on your 30-day volume tier
Hold at least 1 point to be eligible to sign the VAR terms and claim at TGE
airdrops.backers: Dragonfly, Coinbase Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto

airdrops.name: Nullmask Season 1
airdrops.desc: ZK privacy pool. Season 1 converts points to MASK at a fixed rate, paid to a linked Solana wallet. Earn by holding a balance, private withdrawals and referrals.
steps: Open the Nullmask app and connect an EVM wallet, then sign the one-time account message
Shield (deposit) a supported asset into the private pool
Keep a balance: holding earns daily points; withdrawals earn more (Big Wave mode gives 1.5x)
Link a Solana wallet to receive MASK at the end of the season

airdrops.name: Canopy Network
airdrops.desc: Appchain L1 framework with a free testnet. Loyalty points convert to CNPY at a future TGE (date not announced).
steps: Open the Canopy Rewards Hub and connect an EVM wallet and your X account
Claim free test CNPY from the testnet dashboard
Deploy your own testnet L1: it earns the highest points multiplier
Check in daily and complete quests; referrals earn 20% of their points

airdrops.name: Flop Labs
airdrops.desc: Testnet reported to open on November 24, 2026 with an airdrop attached, per a KuCoin report citing Arthur Hayes.
steps: Follow the project's official X account for the launch link
Prepare a fresh wallet for testnet activity
Join on launch day and complete the testnet tasks

airdrops.name: Elysium
airdrops.desc: HyperEVM Layer 2 DeFi chain from the Kinetiq team, mainnet live since November 9. No token announced yet.
steps: Get the official link from Kinetiq's X account
Bridge a small amount to Elysium
Use the chain's DeFi apps regularly

airdrops.name: Note Systems
airdrops.desc: Onchain structured notes on testnet with free mock assets. Points are live, but a NOTE distribution to testers is not confirmed.
steps: Open the Note Systems testnet from the official site
Take COUPON or SHIELD positions with free mock assets
Keep a streak going to earn more points

airdrops.name: Metric
airdrops.desc: Top-tier watchlist project with a vault and referral program. Points only, no token confirmed. About $5 and 20 minutes to start.
steps: Find the official app link on Metric's X account
Deposit a small amount into the vault
Track your points on the dashboard

airdrops.name: Pharos
airdrops.desc: Claim for testnet, staking, Discord and OKX Wallet users. The window has closed.
steps: Claim window closed
